note: Scenario vectors: each entry names a retained-evidence scenario the fixture builder constructs, and the fail-closed outcome the engine MUST produce. Receipt hashes and wall-clock values are intentionally NOT pinned (iat is second-resolution wall clock); the pinned surface is the decision-comparison semantics.

vectors.name: honest_full_replay
vectors.scenario: two allowed calls with stored args, one denied call with no stored args, original policy retained, alternative policy supplied

vectors.name: deterministic_output_bytes
vectors.scenario: the same chain and evidence replayed twice

vectors.name: tampered_stored_args_rebinds_to_receipt_digest
vectors.scenario: one stored input's text is rewritten (its store hash field recomputed so the store accepts it); the receipt binds the ORIGINAL args digest

vectors.name: tampered_store_record_reads_as_missing
vectors.scenario: one stored input's text is rewritten WITHOUT fixing the store hash field; InputStore's own integrity recheck treats it as absent

vectors.name: missing_policy_artifact
vectors.scenario: the policy directory retains NO artifacts

vectors.name: policy_digest_mismatch
vectors.scenario: a policy artifact IS retained but its content was edited so no rule reproduces the receipts' bound digest

vectors.name: forged_receipt_decision_diverges
vectors.scenario: a receipt's signed payload is altered (decided deny) and re-signed with the gate key; the evidence still recomputes allow

vectors.name: counterfactual_variant_joined_by_receipt
vectors.scenario: alternative policy allows only ACC-001; the ACC-999 decision must carry counterfactual_decision deny

vectors.name: bounded_disclosure
vectors.scenario: any replay report over the fixture chain

vectors.name: no_policy_digest_honestly_resolvable
vectors.scenario: a receipt binds the stable no-policy digest; the empty retained recompute environment resolves it and the deny recomputes
